in_hebrew.name: חרדיג
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'chadeg', meaning 'strong, powerful, mighty, hero'. The name Hardigg can be seen as a combination of 'hard' (strong, powerful) and 'ig' (hero).

in_greek.name: Χαρδίγγος
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'chardings', meaning 'strong, brave, manly, hero'. The name Hardigg can be seen as a combination of 'hard' (strong, brave) and 'ig' (hero).

in_latin.name: Hardiggus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'hardigus', meaning 'hard, strong, hero'. The name Hardigg can be seen as a combination of 'hard' (hard, strong) and 'ig' (hero).
